summary:
Implementation completed:
- Added Swim Pace Zones derived from Critical Swim Speed (CSS) test adhering to the exact requested offsets:
  - Z1 (Recovery/Easy): CSS +15 to +25s
  - Z2 (Endurance/Ironman): CSS +8 to +15s
  - Z3 (Tempo/Steady aerobic): CSS +3 to +8s
  - Z4 (Threshold/CSS): CSS -2 to +2s
  - Z5 (VO2 Max): CSS -2 to -10s
- Added Swim Heart Rate Zones below Swim TSS Model in Settings > Swim with Swim LTHR and aquatic offset helper.
- Added Swim Heart Rate Protocols modal with British Triathlon, US Masters Swimming, and Joe Friel standards.
- Integrated Pace and HR zone calculations for swim activities into trainingZones.ts and ActivityZoneChart.
- Verified build and TypeScript linting clean.
